# The glossary

One word, one meaning (docs/design/blueprint.md, part 12, decision 7, agreed 15 November 2026). Folders,
commands, docs and lint take their words from the blueprint's glossary, `src/glossary.ts`, which this page is
rendered from. An old word is renamed by a ratchet (roadmap item 3.8): `generated/old-words.json` counts how often
each is still written as a name in code, `pnpm words` fails when a count grows, and a word is done at zero.

Scope: **user-facing** words are seen by callers (operation names, the CLI, the SDK, events, refusals, fields);
**internal** ones only by builders (packages, folders, environment variables, docs).

| Word | What it means | Replaces | Scope |
|---|---|---|---|
| **api** (`packages/api`) | The server that carries out a world's operations. | core | internal |
| **endpoint** (`--world <name>`) | The address a world answers at; the CLI takes the world by name instead. | door, `CAPXUL_DOOR_URL`, `--at` | user-facing |
| **account** | Calls outside any world, and where a person's sign-in lives. | platform, at the platform | user-facing |
| **world** | One whole, isolated Capxul. | (kept) | user-facing |
| **grade** | Whether a world is private, shared or real. | (kept) | user-facing |
| **realm** | Whether a world is for testing or real. | grade group | user-facing |
| **site** | A company's Frappe site, and nothing else. | (kept) | user-facing |
| **cast** | A test world's people. | (kept) | user-facing |
| **operator** | Who owns and runs worlds; the faucet's account is the faucet. | owner | user-facing |
| **cluster** | The shared containers worlds run on. | hub, fleet, fleet hub | user-facing |
| **gateway** | The cluster's single address. | hub door | internal |
| **sites** (`packages/sites`) | What hosts company sites; bench stays Frappe's word. | platform, `packages/platform` | user-facing |
| **site service** | The bench service that makes, takes, saves and resets sites. | site door | internal |
| **site API** | The Capxul app's side that accepts signed calls. | `door.py` | internal |
| **collector** | Where telemetry is sent and routed. | telemetry door | internal |
| **stage** | A deployed instance of a stack. | (kept) | internal |
| **snapshot** | A saved state of a world; a site's part of it is a site snapshot. | point, backup, chain snapshot | user-facing |
| **starting point** | A named state a journey begins from. | starting world, template snapshot | user-facing |
| **site template** | A ready copy of a starting point's sites on the bench. | template | internal |
| **take** | Giving a world sites from the pool. | claim | internal |
| **reserve** | Holding a world's name. | claim | internal |
| **journey** (`packages/journeys`) | A written story of operations that must pass. | scenario | user-facing |
| **runner** | What runs and judges journeys; the thing it makes is a run. | (kept) | user-facing |
| **shard** | One world of a run's several. | lane (counted only in `packages/runner/`) | user-facing |
| **promise** | A sentence an operation guarantees. | claim | user-facing |
| **claim** | Claiming a person's Safe on chain, through Companies House. | (kept) | user-facing |
| **check** | What judges one call or run, and only that. | (kept) | internal |
| **gate** (`pnpm gate`) | The pass every pull request clears; its levels are rungs. | `pnpm check`, ladder | internal |
| **verdict** | What a CI run proved. | run record, proof record | user-facing |
| **logbook** | The one store of what happened: runs, verdicts, tasks, asks, threads, sitreps and the plan's state. | (kept) | internal |
| **history** | A world's ordered history. | record, `record.export` | user-facing |
| **span** | A timed piece of work inside an operation. | step (not counted) | internal |
| **step** | One move of a journey, and only that. | (kept) | internal |
| **tap** | A test world's own telemetry copy. | (kept) | internal |
| **registry** | The cluster's list of worlds. | ledger | internal |
| **index.ts** | The file other packages import from. | `door.ts` | internal |
| **generated index** | The blueprint's gathering files. | hub | internal |
| **item** | One line of the roadmap. | step (not counted) | internal |
| **lane** | A chain of roadmap items led by one lead. | (kept) | internal |
| **slice** | An integration branch for one effort. | (kept) | internal |

## Old words not counted

Each is spelled as a word the glossary keeps for another concept, so no count can tell its uses apart.

- `step`, becoming **span**: `step` stays the word for one move of a journey, so a count of it cannot tell this meaning apart.
- `step`, becoming **item**: `step` stays the word for one move of a journey, so a count of it cannot tell this meaning apart.

## Where a kept word is not counted

A word the glossary keeps, spelled as another entry's old word, is not counted where this exact code writes it.

- **claim**: `CompaniesHouseClaimer.claim`, `claim(string,string,address)`, `capxul.claim`.

## Exact text not counted

No writer can choose these, so an entry's old words are not counted in them. Nor in a package's name written as a package (`@capxul/core`, `packages/core`, `--core=local`), an import or export specifier, or an applied migration's file name: each changes only with what it names.

- **api**: `core-db`, a resource already deployed under this name: renaming it replaces the resource.
- **api**: `core-hyperdrive`, a resource already deployed under this name: renaming it replaces the resource.
- **endpoint**: `DoorImage`, a resource already deployed under this name: renaming it replaces the resource.
- **endpoint**: `DoorRecord`, a resource already deployed under this name: renaming it replaces the resource.
- **endpoint**: `cx-platform-door`, a resource already deployed under this name: renaming it replaces the resource.
- **account**: `CapxulPlatform`, an Alchemy stack already deployed under this name: renaming it replaces every resource in it.
- **account**: `cx-platform-bench`, a resource already deployed under this name: renaming it replaces the resource.
- **account**: `cx-platform-door`, a resource already deployed under this name: renaming it replaces the resource.
- **account**: `capxul-ci-platform`, a resource already deployed under this name: renaming it replaces the resource.
- **account**: `platform.yml`, an existing workflow file, renamed with the package.
- **cluster**: `CapxulWorldHub`, an Alchemy stack already deployed under this name: renaming it replaces every resource in it.
- **snapshot**: `dataPoints`, OpenTelemetry's OTLP wire format names it, not Capxul.
- **snapshot**: `rejectedDataPoints`, OpenTelemetry's OTLP wire format names it, not Capxul.
- **snapshot**: `metric_data_point`, OpenTelemetry's OTLP wire format names it, not Capxul.
- **snapshot**: `data_point`, OpenTelemetry's OTLP wire format names it, not Capxul.
- **history**: `logRecords`, OpenTelemetry's OTLP wire format names it, not Capxul.
- **history**: `rejectedLogRecords`, OpenTelemetry's OTLP wire format names it, not Capxul.
- **history**: `log_record`, OpenTelemetry's OTLP wire format names it, not Capxul.
- **history**: `DoorRecord`, a resource already deployed under this name: renaming it replaces the resource.
